story.fullStory:
Filter's "Take A Picture" reached #12 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Take a Picture" is a song by American rock band Filter.

It was serviced to radio in September 1999 as the second single from their second studio album, Title of Record (1999).

The song became a hit at the start of 2000 following its January 18 retail release, peaking at number 12 on the US Billboard Hot 100 and number three in Canada.

The song peaked at #12 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.
